text: Dorothy Thurtle's Abortion: Right or Wrong?, published by T. Werner Laurie Limited, London, was banned in Ireland in 1942. It appears in the Register of Prohibited Publications, Part II, and a 2025 parliamentary answer explicitly cited it by name as still listed. The legal basis for the register was abolished in 2018.
meta_description: Abortion: Right or Wrong? by Dorothy Thurtle was banned in Ireland in 1942 and was still listed in the Register of Prohibited Publications in 2025.
